budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Rome? Hotel Prices for Rome, Italy | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: $137 is the average price of the 2,061 1-star hotels in Rome; BudgetYourTrip states hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes. Its Rome cost page reports $206 (€180) for two people in a typical double-occupancy hotel room.
budgetyourtripProxy.referencePeriod: Search results retrieved 2026-08-01; source page uses current listing sample.
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Source-defined class average retained as a proxy only; it is not a directly observed two-adult booking quote.
